meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上后,面对长期或多步骤目标时,Claude 会采用“目标式循环”:把工作拆成极细的步骤,每一步都绑定真实证据,并按检查点推进、做手工 QA,而不是一次性含糊完成。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-loop”或“ulw”等关键词,或要求执行基于证据、带检查点的长期任务时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 模式完成这个项目,拆成小步骤并留证据。
say.note: 会进入目标式循环,逐步验收。

say.text: 启动 ulw,做一次持久目标执行,手工 QA。
say.note: 按工作流先读完整流程再执行。

say.text: 以证据驱动的方式处理这个长期任务,带检查点。
say.note: 会绑定真实表面证据,并跟踪进度。

howto.what_en: When handling a long or multi-step goal, Claude adopts a goal-like loop: it decomposes the work into tiny steps, binds each to real evidence, and moves through manual QA checkpoints instead of one-shot vague completion.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says keywords like “ulw-loop” or “ulw”, or asks for evidence-based, checkpointed long-running tasks.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop mode for this project: break it into small steps and keep evidence.
say_en.note: Enters the goal-like loop with step-by-step verification.

say_en.text: Start ulw, run a durable goal execution with manual QA.
say_en.note: Reads the full workflow first, then executes.

say_en.text: Handle this long-running task in an evidence-driven way with checkpoints.
say_en.note: Binds evidence to real surfaces and tracks progress.
